newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Building groups welcome Australian rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Building groups welcome Australian rate cut.

text.p: The Real Estate Institute of Australia said on Wednesday the 0.5 percent cut in official interest rates should encourage more first home buyers into the market.
"First home buyers have been very cautious about entering the market recently," president Don Brindley said in a statement.
"Decreases in mortgage interest rates will encourage higher rates of home ownership, and thus help the property sector to emerge strongly from its recent downturn."
The Reserve Bank of Australia earlier on Wednesday eased monetary policy, dropping its overnight cash rate target to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.
Brindley said the rate cut should also lift business and employment confidence, but only if the banks immediately passed on the reduction.

"The rate cut is expected to buoy business and employment confidence, jolting the economy out of its current sluggish state," he said. "However, this will only occur if rate cuts are immediately passed on as decreases in interest rates on mortgages and commercial loans."
